main_text.p: γράφω, ἔγραφον, γράψω, γέγραφα, scribo. πλάσσω, ἔπλασσον, πλάσσω, πέπλασμαι, fingo.
Sic Latini interdum reduplicant: ut tango, tetigi: pello, pepuli.

Γν & γεν non repetunt literam thematis, quia tum prima non habetur anceps, sed longa tantúm: γνόω, ἔγνωον, γνώσω, ἔγνωκα, nosco: sic γνωείζω, ἐγνώεi-ζον, γνωείσω, ἐγνώεικα, nosco: γεννράω, ἐγεννράων, γεννρήσω, ἐγεννρηκα, vigilo. sic ἔκρυφα pro κέκρυφα, ἀ κρύπτω occulo. Contrá ἀ πλάω paveo, πέπληκα: ἀ πλόω cado, πέπτωκα, repetunt, quia syllabam communem faciunt.
main_text.head: Mutatio vocalium.
main_text.p: Penultima futuri disyllabi in ρω, λω, νω, mutat horistico ε in α: & in μω interponit η: & in his singulis ultima mutat ω in κα, tollitqueν in ἑνω, ἰνω, ιω: at αἰνω mutat in γ: ut

page.notes: Greek text is partly blurred; Greek accents and breathings in the first lines are uncertain. The heading "Mutatio vocalium." is a run-in heading in italic and may be treated as a heading.
